# Village of Newbury municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 16; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 247 (Village of Newbury): section 401 provides for a Moderator elected at the village annual meeting; the village has no website and no official source located publishes its current officers, so the post is created without a membership

24 App. V.S.A. ch. 247 (Village of Newbury): section 401 provides for three Trustees; no official source located publishes the current trustees, so the post is created without memberships. Section 701 sets the annual meeting on the fourth Tuesday of May
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 247 (Village of Newbury): section 401 provides for a Clerk elected at the annual meeting; no holder is published in any official source located
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 247 (Village of Newbury): section 401 provides for a Treasurer elected at the annual meeting; no holder is published in any official source located
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 247 (Village of Newbury): section 401 provides for three Auditors elected at the annual meeting; no holders are published in any official source located
